projects.name: humemory
projects.tagline: Shared agent memory with decay, cues and reviewed routines
projects.description: Memory engine for AI agents modeled on human recall. It keeps decaying traces, open intentions, provenance and reviewed cognitive scripts in SQLite, then retrieves them through lexical and vector search. Claude hooks plus explicit Codex, Kimi Code and OpenCode importers feed one MCP store; background maintenance stays off the agent path and falls back to deterministic local processing when no model is available.
highlights: Offline core with optional model-assisted maintenance
Shared MCP store · provenance · contradiction handling
Measured retrieval quality and index rebuild cost

projects.name: acp-team
projects.tagline: One MCP control plane for Kimi, Codex, OpenCode and Ollama
projects.description: Extensible MCP control plane that puts ACP, CLI and HTTP-backed agents behind one supervised interface. Bundled adapters cover Kimi, Codex, OpenCode and Ollama; sessions, live progress, cancellation, usage and results follow one contract. Write-capable runs use authorization tokens scoped to the agent, working directory, mode, lifetime and use count.
highlights: Live progress, cancellation and normalized usage

projects.name: wollama-monorepo
projects.tagline: Local-first AI chat: web, desktop and mobile with Ollama
projects.description: Cross-platform AI chat application powered by Ollama for local, private inference. Conversations, companions and settings remain available offline, then RxDB syncs them with PouchDB when the server returns. Voice I/O, RAG, skills, hooks and web agents run in the browser, Electron desktop app and Capacitor mobile app; a provider registry now isolates model backends from conversation orchestration.
highlights: Voice · RAG · skills · hooks · web agents

projects.name: domus
projects.tagline: Rust UI framework for reactive web and native desktop apps
projects.description: Alpha Rust UI framework with signal/effect reactivity, RSX macros, scoped CSS, keyed lists, routing, context and a growing component library for WebAssembly apps. Its independent desktop runtime uses native webviews without Tauri, and the CLI can scaffold projects and assemble portable desktop bundles.
highlights: Fine-grained signals, effects and automatic disposal
RSX · routing · scoped CSS · reusable components
Independent desktop runtime and portable bundles

projects.name: Idae
projects.tagline: DDD multi-tenant platform with MongoDB-like query engine
projects.description: Full-stack monorepo powering Idae-Machine, a domain-driven multi-tenant SvelteKit application. Ships a MongoDB-like query engine, real-time socket layer, reactive state management, and a pluggable API backend, all typed end-to-end in TypeScript.

projects.name: sive
projects.tagline: AI writing assistant: production since v1.0
projects.description: Full-featured writing application with real-time AI suggestions, narrative coherence analysis, and mobile-first design. Built on SvelteKit 5 and Tailwind v4. Production-ready since v1.0 with a clean, distraction-free editor.

projects.name: @medyll/css-base
projects.tagline: Native CSS design system: modular, themeable, zero build
projects.description: Published CSS design system built entirely on native platform features: cascade layers, OKLCH, light-dark(), CSS @function, and typed attr(). Version 0.7.13 ships modular entry points, reusable components and utilities, plus ten token-only demo skins—with no preprocessor, build step, or JavaScript runtime.
highlights: Modular exports · cascade layers · native dark mode

projects.name: latent-line
projects.tagline: AI-driven scene and story production pipeline
projects.description: SvelteKit SPA for orchestrating AI-driven story and scene production. Combines an interactive timeline editor with asset management, real-time model inspection, and a CI pipeline on GitHub Actions.

projects.name: @medyll/svelte-5-documentor
projects.tagline: AST-based metadata extractor for Svelte 5 components
projects.description: Parses Svelte 5 component source via AST to extract props, exports, generics, and JSDoc comments, generating structured documentation without invoking the compiler. Drop-in for any TypeScript toolchain.

projects.name: Registry Mind
projects.tagline: Android on-device OCR sensor synced over Tailscale
projects.description: Android screen-capture sensor for Oppo Find X9. Triggers via Snap Key, runs on-device OCR with ML Kit, and syncs results to an OpenClaw desktop instance over Tailscale, replacing Oppo's proprietary AI Mind Space with a fully self-hosted pipeline.
highlights: On-device OCR via ML Kit, no cloud

projects.name: Protonesk
projects.tagline: ProtonMail via IMAP/SMTP/CardDAV: MCP bridge over hydroxide
projects.description: MCP server that bridges ProtonMail's encrypted ecosystem to any standard mail client. Built on top of hydroxide, it exposes IMAP, SMTP, and CardDAV endpoints. Ships with Windows auto-start and zero-config setup.

projects.name: jobber
projects.tagline: Local resume tailor: Ollama rewrite, ATS PDF, Playwright autofill
projects.description: Local-first tool that matches your resume to a job description, rewrites targeted sections with Ollama, generates ATS-friendly PDFs, and auto-fills job applications via Playwright. No cloud, no subscription, no data sent externally.
highlights: Fully local: no cloud, no API key

projects.name: pseudo-stack
projects.tagline: Vanilla HTML component system: 7.7 KB, zero dependencies
projects.description: Zero-dependency vanilla HTML component system at 7.7 KB gzip. Provides a structured tag taxonomy, display-hint suffixes, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility out of the box, no build step, no framework, no lock-in.
highlights: WCAG 2.2 AA out of the box

projects.name: SingletonNotepad
projects.tagline: Windows 11 notepad backed by a single Markdown file
projects.description: Minimal WinUI 3 notepad that persists everything in one Markdown file. Auto-saves every 2 seconds with optional LLM normalization to keep notes structured. Single binary, no sync service, no account.

projects.name: Idae Legacy
projects.tagline: Migrating a 2014 PHP/MongoDB CMS to a 2026 stack
projects.description: Live migration of a legacy PHP 5.6, Node.js and MongoDB CMS onto PHP 8.2, a current MongoDB driver and a Dockerized environment. The original UI and behavior stay intact while Phase 2 rewrites CRUD, session and database internals; Apache/PHP and Socket.IO now run together in one supervised application image.
highlights: One supervised image for Apache/PHP + Socket.IO

projects.name: idae.api
projects.tagline: PHP/MongoDB REST + IDQL API for the Idae platform
projects.description: Lightweight PHP REST API backed by MongoDB, built around a router → API parser → query layer pattern. Exposes a custom IDQL query language for find/group/distinct/parallel operations alongside generic REST endpoints, plus a small Node helper process for sockets and crons. Dockerized with a PHPUnit test suite.
highlights: IDQL query language: find, group, distinct, parallel
Router → API parser → query layer architecture

projects.name: Qoolie
projects.tagline: Client-side IndexedDB the easy way, with server sync
projects.description: Client database IndexedDB the easy way, add server sync
highlights: React, Vue and Svelte adapters + devtools
Sync via idae-socket, offline-first by default

projects.name: @medyll/idae-be
projects.tagline: Callback-based DOM manipulation library, always returns the root
projects.description: A DOM walk and manipulation library with a callback-based approach for precise element targeting. Unlike jQuery-style chaining, idae-be always returns the root object, using callbacks to reach into nested matches while keeping the chain consistent.
highlights: Callback-based targeting, root object always returned
Traversal, styling, attributes, events in one API

projects.name: @medyll/idae-dom-events
projects.tagline: CSS and DOM mutation observers for reactive UI code
projects.description: Library for observing and reacting to DOM changes: cssDom tracks animations, style changes and resize events, htmlDom.track observes attribute, child-list and character-data mutations. Built for dynamic web applications that need fine-grained change detection.

projects.name: idae-router
projects.tagline: Framework-agnostic SPA router with SWR cache and typed HTTP fetching
projects.description: Lightweight, framework-agnostic client-side router: path parameters, query parsing, lifecycle hooks, declarative HTTP data fetching, an in-memory SWR cache, and full TypeScript generics. Supports nested routes and outlets.
highlights: In-memory SWR cache with hover prefetching

projects.name: @medyll/idae-stator
projects.tagline: Universal deep-reactive state via native Proxy, zero dependencies
projects.description: Lightweight, universal, deeply reactive state management library. Uses native Proxy to track mutations at any depth in objects and arrays, and exposes both onchange callbacks and a standard EventTarget API, isomorphic across Browser, Node.js and SSR.
highlights: Deep reactivity via recursive Proxy + WeakMap cache

projects.name: @medyll/idae-sync
projects.tagline: Offline-first sync engine: outbox, retries, conflict resolution
projects.description: Syncs local IndexedDB data to a server automatically, in the background, even offline. Writes are intercepted into an IndexedDB-backed outbox with exponential backoff, circuit breakers, a dead letter queue, and pluggable conflict resolution (last-write-wins, shallow or field-level merge).
highlights: Outbox + circuit breaker + dead letter queue
mobile-first / server-first sync modes per collection
SSE/WebSocket push listeners, pluggable conflict resolution

projects.name: infra-ansible-legacy
projects.tagline: 2019 Ansible playbook provisioning a telco API stack
projects.description: Legacy Ansible playbook provisioning a telco API platform (PHP7, Nginx, MySQL, Redis) across dev/preprod/prod. Environment identity and per-host config live in group_vars/host_vars, keeping the common role environment-agnostic. Archived as a portfolio reference with credentials stripped to ansible-vault placeholders.
highlights: Same role runs unmodified across dev/preprod/prod
group_vars/host_vars scoping, no hardcoded env in tasks

projects.name: Ferule-Core
projects.tagline: Research space for formal languages of cognition and org structure
projects.description: Exploratory research project defining two formal languages, a matrix topology language and a dynamic structural mapping model, to express cognition and organizational structure. Includes an LLM engine for generating context-aware indicators across 9 domains and an interactive 3D visualization built with Three.js.
highlights: Two formal languages: matrix topology + structural mapping
